formation: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 柬 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "boil and scour raw silk" to make it softer and whiter. The meaning later shifted to "to make perfect" and "to practice". Simplified form of 練.

components.note: 纟 is a component form of 糸.
Derived from the cursive form of the traditional 柬 component.
